one_line: Early 7th‑century emperor of Kannauj who ruled the Ganga plains and patronised Buddhist and Brahmanical institutions.

appearance.age_look: Looks around 30–35 years old, tall and lean with a wiry, disciplined build of an active king who rides and campaigns.
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones, straight nose, medium‑full lips and a calm, observant gaze; medium wheatish North Indian complexion; thin arched eyebrows and a faint vertical tilak line on the forehead; default expression is composed and thoughtful, with a subtle hint of warmth when he speaks to others.
appearance.hair: Thick, wavy black hair drawn up into a high topknot at the back of the crown, wrapped with a narrow gold headband; the front hairline is clean with a few soft strands falling near the temples, and he wears no crown, only the simple band as a royal diadem.
appearance.costume: Era‑accurate 7th‑century North Indian royal outfit: a long, knee‑length angarkha‑style wrap tunic in soft off‑white cotton with a slight V‑neck, edged with a narrow maroon border, worn over a fitted, ankle‑length dhoti in muted golden‑yellow with fine maroon and dark green stripes near the hem; a rich, deep‑green silk uttariya (shawl) with thin gold woven borders drapes from his left shoulder across the torso and around his back, leaving both arms covered modestly; he wears a narrow maroon cloth belt at the waist with a small gold clasp, simple gold armlets on both upper arms, a single flat gold necklace with a round pendant, and modest gold stud earrings; on his feet are brown leather sandals with toe straps, appropriate for court and travel; textiles look finely woven but not overly ornate, suggesting a king known for austerity as well as splendour.
appearance.signature: A slender, slightly curved steel sword with a simple straight cross‑guard and a brown leather‑wrapped hilt, carried in a plain dark‑brown scabbard with minimal gold fittings and a narrow strap that lets it hang at his left hip.

ref_desc: Harsha is a tall, lean man of about 30–35 with a wheatish complexion, wavy black hair in a high topknot wrapped by a narrow gold headband, wearing an off‑white angarkha, golden‑yellow striped dhoti, deep‑green shawl, maroon belt, simple gold ornaments, brown sandals, and a plain curved sword at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full‑body anime‑style model sheet of Harsha of Kannauj: a tall, lean North Indian king of about 30–35 with an oval face, wheatish complexion, high cheekbones, calm thoughtful expression, thin arched eyebrows, and a faint vertical tilak on his forehead. His thick wavy black hair is pulled into a high topknot at the back of the crown, wrapped with a narrow gold headband, with a few soft strands near the temples. He wears an era‑accurate early 7th‑century royal outfit: a long knee‑length off‑white cotton angarkha‑style wrap tunic with a slight V‑neck and a narrow maroon border, over an ankle‑length golden‑yellow dhoti with fine maroon and dark green stripes near the hem, tied neatly. A rich deep‑green silk uttariya shawl with thin gold woven borders drapes from his left shoulder across his torso and around his back, covering him modestly while still allowing free movement. At his waist is a narrow maroon cloth belt with a small gold clasp. He has simple gold armlets on both upper arms, a flat gold necklace with a round pendant, modest gold stud earrings, and brown leather sandals with toe straps. His signature weapon is a slender, slightly curved steel sword with a straight cross‑guard and brown leather‑wrapped hilt, hanging in a plain dark‑brown scabbard with minimal gold fittings at his left hip. Use an anime shonen aesthetic but keep the costume and accessories historically grounded, with a colour palette of off‑white, golden‑yellow, deep green, maroon, and brown leather, and show front, side, and back views to make his face, hair, clothing, and sword easy to redraw consistently.
